# ankra_organisation_member (Resource)

A member of an organisation, added by invitation. The counterpart of `ankra org invite` and `ankra org remove`.

The API offers API tokens no role change, so changing `role` removes the member and invites them again; an active member is then pending until they accept.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_organisation_member" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
  role  = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address invited. The member's account may carry a different address (a relay address, for example), so this is not read back.
- `role` (String) Role: `member`, `admin` or `read-only`. Changing it re-invites the member.

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation to invite into. Defaults to the provider's `organisation_id`, or the token's current organisation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The member's user id.
- `invite_id` (String) Identifier of the membership row the invite created.
- `status` (String) Membership status, `pending` until the invite is accepted, then `active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Members are imported by "<organisation_id>/<user_id>".
terraform import ankra_organisation_member.alice 6f1c2b8e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/0b7d5a10-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
